subject: Mid-cycle pulse: scope tighten, runway asks, and mutual action plan
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Courtney Lee <courtney@clockwisehealth.com>, Anna Kim <anna.kim@vendorops.io>
Date: 2026-08-24T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mid-cycle pulse: scope tighten, runway asks, and mutual action plan

Team — attaching a short MID-Q snapshot (attached) and call out the minimal set of scope decisions + dependency asks we need to lock by next week so QBR materials are accurate. Please reply with owners/ETAs inline.

Quick status (objective-level):
- OKR: Reduce inference unit cost by 25% — current trajectory ~11% improvement (work in progress: batching + quantization research).
- OKR: 99th-pct latency SLO for chat routes — currently 120ms P50 / 520ms P99; target P99 <= 350ms.
- OKR: Platform reliability — error budget burn 0.8% this quarter, trending healthy but a 1.5% risk on a single GPU driver change.

Key re-scope proposals (need alignment):
1) Defer non-critical eval matrix expansion (NLP QA variants) from Sept -> Oct to free 2 eng-weeks.
2) Narrow rollout of new quantized model to beta customers only (clockwise is ok to be in beta) — removes broad-market rollout dependency.
3) Pause ML infra experiment on multi-GPU KV-sharding until next quarter; reallocate infra FTE to observability and dashboarding.

Dependency asks (owners/desired ETA):
- Dedicated infra capacity for mid-Q burst (2x A100 for 4 weeks) — owner: Markus? ETA: Sep 6
- SOC2 evidence for Cloud Prod-access audit (Clockwise requires before pilot) — owner: Priya/security. ETA: Aug 31
- Per-route P99 breakdown dashboard for chat & embeddings (needed for QBR) — owner: Vanessa/observability. ETA: Sep 3

Attachments: MIDQ-OKR-snapshot.pdf (high-level slides).

Next steps: please reply with yes/no + owner + realistic ETA. If quiet, I'll escalate to exec steer on Friday.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Director, Product Strategy — Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Courtney Lee <courtney@clockwisehealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-24T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle pulse: scope tighten, runway asks, and mutual action plan

Mina — thanks for the clear ask. Quick replies inline: 

- Infra burst: I can commit to carving 2x A100 from reserved pool for 4 weeks, start date Sep 6. I'll own allocation and cost tracking (will post cost delta by EOD Monday).
- Dashboard: can assign one infra SRE + observability eng to build the per-route P99 view; target Sep 3 is tight but achievable if we scope to chat + embeddings only.
- Quantization rollout: agree to beta-only pin for Clockwise. We'll do a canary of 5% of their traffic then ramp based on perf signals.

Minor ask: to hit the P99 target we should prioritize the attention kernel improvements in the next sprint; I'll sync with infra compilers team to accelerate.

Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Infrastructure
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle pulse: scope tighten, runway asks, and mutual action plan

Quick flag — SOC2 artifacts are the gating item for Clockwise pilot. Security has backlog and the evidence package (prod access logs + config baselines) ownership sits in compliance. Priya: can you confirm whether we have a fast-track path or whether we need to offer a temporary contract clause? Also, the dashboard ETA depends on access to partitioned request logs (we'll need a short-lived query role).

I'll start the dashboard proto once I have log access and Markus's infra allocation confirmed.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Reliability
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Courtney Lee <courtney@clockwisehealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle pulse: scope tighten, runway asks, and mutual action plan

Vanessa / team — I'm pulling the SOC2 evidence package together. Two operational notes: 
1) We can provide a curated evidence bundle (config baselines + access logs + control descriptions) by Aug 31, but prod access screenshots and signed attestations will follow and likely take until Sept 10.
2) If Clockwise needs pilot-start before full attestations, we can propose a temporary contractual addendum limiting data retention and scope (I can draft language).

Attached: SOC2-evidence-request.docx (list of artifacts I need from infra & eng owners). Markus / infra: I need the list of hosts and the audit log export path. Vanessa: please prepare the partitioned query role request.

Priya
Priya Natarajan
Head of Security & Compliance
From: Courtney Lee <courtney@clockwisehealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-26T11:47:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle pulse: scope tighten, runway asks, and mutual action plan

Thanks for the update, Mina and team. Clockwise is comfortable being in the quantization beta and with a canary approach. A few asks from our side so we can align QBR expectations:
- Confirm model pin (name + version) you plan to canary and expected P99 improvement range for chat routes.
- Proposed pilot start window around Sep 7–10 (we need 48h notice to coordinate traffic routing).
- Weekly 30-min sync for the pilot (Tues/Thurs mornings E.T. preferred).

We appreciate the SOC2 evidence timeline; the addendum path is fine as a fallback. Looking forward to the dashboard when available.

Best,
Courtney Lee
Head of Data & Integrations — Clockwise Health
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Courtney Lee <courtney@clockwisehealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-26T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle pulse: scope tighten, runway asks, and mutual action plan

Thanks, everyone — summarized decisions and owners (taking on execution):

Decisions locked:
- Quantization rollback/rollout: beta-only for Clockwise; canary at 5% -> 25% -> 100% if signals OK.
- Non-critical eval expansion deferred to Oct.
- Multi-GPU KV-sharding experiment paused for this quarter.

Action owners + ETAs:
- Markus: allocate 2x A100 (Sep 6 start) + post cost delta (ETA: 2026-08-31).
- Vanessa: provisional per-route P99 dashboard (chat & embeddings) (ETA: 2026-09-03).
- Priya: curated SOC2 evidence bundle (ETA: 2026-08-31) and suggested contract addendum draft if needed (ETA: 2026-09-04).
- Mina (me): QBR narrative update and slide deck refresh (ETA: 2026-09-02); will run a 20-min pre-brief with leadership on Sep 4.

Courtney — we'll confirm the model pin and expected P99 delta by EOD Monday (Markus and compilers team to weigh in). Pilot window Sep 7–10 looks feasible if SOC2 evidence bundle is available; we'll give 48h notice for traffic routing.

If anyone sees a high-risk blocker to these ETAs, flag it here by end of day Monday and I'll escalate. Planning a 30-min pilot sync Tues 9/8 11:00am ET (I'll send calendar invite).
